notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for direct ordinary regional attribute-update delivery. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies object registration with regions, source-region designators, current-overlap re-evaluation at callback delivery, receive-order evoked suppression after a region mutation, immediate delivery boundaries, restored overlap, and lifecycle cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional publication, subscription, registration, region modification, and Update Attribute Values services with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
